mapper.sql: SELECT p.*, c.category_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board_comments b WHERE b.post_id = p.post_id) AS comment_count FROM board_posts p JOIN board_categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
mapper.select: SELECT category_id AS id, category_name AS name FROM board_categories ORDER BY category_id
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM board_categories WHERE category_id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM board_comments WHERE post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY comment_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board_comments (post_id, member_id, author_name, school_name, content) VALUES (#{postId}, #{memberId}, #{authorName}, #{schoolName}, #{content})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM board_comments WHERE comment_id = #{id} AND member_id = #{memberId}
